title: Deadly Truth of General AI? - Computerphile
summary: A Computerphile video in which Rob Miles warns against assuming a general AI will think like a human. He uses the thought experiment of a stamp-collecting AI to show how a goal-driven system could pursue its aim with dangerous results.
why: Often pointed to as an accessible first introduction to AI safety and why a superintelligent AI could be dangerous.

quote.text: There's a great Computerphile video from 2015 that introduced me to the idea of AI safety awhile ago.
